tests: [pipe.test] Puppeteer.launch should support the pipe argument
reason: Passes `--remote-debugging-pipe` as a launch argument. Strider's Chromium launch gives the browser its own pipe, so an argument the caller adds is a second copy of a flag Strider sets, and no Strider behavior depends on it

tests: [pipe.test] Puppeteer.launch should support the pipe option
reason: Puppeteer's pipe transport is Chromium's `--remote-debugging-pipe`: Firefox has no such argument (Puppeteer skips it there), and stock WebKit's inspector has no pipe. The port runs the pipe launch on Chromium only

tests: [pipe.test] Puppeteer.launch should fire "disconnected" when closing with pipe
reason: Waits for the browser's `disconnected` event after the browser process is killed. Strider has no browser-level disconnected event: a browser's end shows on its pages and contexts, not on the browser
